title: 文化程度检定
purpose: Transformative timed English-deciphering exercise using small excerpts of actual Xu Bing Square Word Calligraphy. Not an official Xu Bing project or a genuine educational qualification.

sources.title: Square Word Calligraphy: Art for the People
sources.rights: © Xu Bing; source image not an open-source font
sources.verification: Artist explicitly decodes ART / FOR / THE / PEOPLE in own essay; source caption identifies artwork.

sources.title: Square Word Calligraphy: Will, Power, Dream (award keywords)
sources.rights: © Xu Bing; source image not an open-source font
sources.verification: Artist supplies three words, and captioned 2009 award photo verifies TOP=WILL, BOTTOM LEFT=POWER, BOTTOM RIGHT=DREAM.

sources.title: Which is infinite
sources.rights: © Xu Bing; source image not an open-source font
sources.verification: Artist explicitly gives WHICH IS INFINITE left to right; signature at right excluded from word crops.

sources.title: An Introduction to Square Word Calligraphy / Square Word Calligraphy Red Line Tracing Book
sources.rights: © Xu Bing; source image not an open-source font
sources.verification: Studio photograph shows right-hand page reading down each column left-to-right: LITTLE BO PEEP LITTLE / BO PEEP HAS LOST / HER SHEEP AND CAN. Reed College collection account verifies Little Bo Peep nursery rhyme text.
